answer_1.quote: We propose user-driven NMT task, which aims to leverage user behavior to generate personalized translations.

answer_2.quote: We assess the translation quality with two metrics: one is case-insensitive BLEU (mteval-v13a.pl) and the other is METEOR (Denkowski and Lavie, 2011).

answer_4.quote: we ask the linguist experts to sort different systems according to the relevance between the generated translations and the historical input.
